{{Quote|Where can I find a N'zothian milk bath? It's absolutely the only treatment my skin will tolerate.|Tyrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''N'zothian milk bath''' was a type of [[Bath/Legends|bath]] that originated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[N'zoth]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] took regular milk baths, believing that it was the only thing that his skin could tolerate.
